what: Split the text into letters (the subtitle into words) and set them to blur 8px and transparent, once the font has loaded, each piece clears up after a delay equal to its horizontal screen position spread over 0~1, 1.2s power2.out — within 2.5s total it sweeps from the left like fog lifting (.2s delay). With on: scroll it fires once when it reaches 75% of the screen

options.split: char (default)·word — each child can also be split separately with data-split
options.on: load (default, after fonts have all arrived) · scroll (ScrollTrigger once)
options.start: Start of on: scroll, default top 75%
options.[data-fx-part=text]: Text group to split (optional) — if empty, the whole attached element
